details.name: Stonewright
details.looks: Rough-hewn grey stone skin, textured like ancient rock. Patinated bronze plating, dulled and streaked with verdigris, melds seamlessly with the stone. A faint, steady electric blue light emanates from thin, visible internal conduits beneath the plating. The silhouette is humanoid, neither overtly masculine nor feminine, with a posture that suggests deep rooting.
details.wearing: No distinct clothing. The aged, patinated metal plating forms integral segments of the body, resembling armor fused to living stone. Bands of tarnished copper wrap around joints, sparking subtly with the internal blue light.
details.face: The face is weathered and gaunt, with deep-set wrinkles around the eyes and mouth. The skin is a pale, greyish tone, resembling rough stone. The eyes glow with an intense, electric blue light. The nose is aquiline, and the mouth is set in a neutral line. Ears are visible and appear to be integrated with the surrounding plating.
details.body: The character has a lean, imposing build. The posture is upright, conveying a sense of rootedness and stability. The proportions suggest a humanoid form, neither overtly masculine nor feminine.
details.hair: The character is bald, with a completely shaved head. The scalp shows a rough, stony texture similar to the rest of the skin. Thin, wire-like conduits are visible on the scalp.
details.style: Their aesthetic is one of primal permanence and elemental artistry. The visual palette is dominated by muted greys, earthy bronzes, and the stark contrast of electric blue. Silhouettes are solid and grounded, exuding an aura of quiet strength and an almost geological presence, suggesting a style that is both timeless and deeply functional, adapted to an environment of ancient forces.
details.personality: Silent observer. Patient and unhurried. Seems to hold ancient knowledge. Reacts to its environment with slow, deliberate movements.
details.voice: When they do speak, it is with a deep, resonant rumble, like stones shifting in the earth's core. The timbre is gravelly, with a low pitch that carries an inherent weight and an almost tectonic deliberation. The voice is rarely raised, maintaining a steady, ground-level hum.
details.speechStyle: Their speech is infrequent and exceptionally measured, with long pauses between phrases. They favor precise, declarative statements, often imbued with an archaic or elemental resonance, eschewing unnecessary adornment or embellishment.
details.tags: ancient, stone, guardian, elemental, observant, resilient, stoic, enduring, silent, grounded

details.name: Juno Vance
details.looks: Human female, late 30s. Sun-weathered skin with fine lines around piercing blue eyes. High cheekbones, a determined jawline. Dark hair pulled taut into a thick, practical braid resting on her shoulder.
details.wearing: A close-fitting, reinforced dark gray jumpsuit. Polished metallic plating integrated into the shoulder and forearm sections. A worn, dark brown leather utility belt cinches her waist, laden with glowing diagnostic tools emitting faint blue and green light, and a small, black data reader.
details.face: Her face is defined by high cheekbones and a determined jawline. Her skin has a sun-kissed texture with visible fine lines around her piercing blue eyes. Her lips are full and her nose is straight.
details.body: She appears to have a lean and athletic build. Her posture is upright and steady.
details.hair: Her dark hair is pulled back tightly and styled into a thick braid that rests on her shoulder. Loose strands frame her face.
details.style: Her aesthetic is decidedly utilitarian and pragmatic, with a palette dominated by dark grays and muted browns. Silhouettes are functional and streamlined, eschewing excess for efficiency. This style communicates a restrained practicality, suited for demanding environments and precise work.
details.personality: Observant, analytical, and highly competent. Driven by a quiet intensity, she approaches tasks with precision and a lack of wasted motion. Prefers action and evidence over speculation.
details.voice: Her voice is a steady, resonant alto with a clear, unhurried cadence. There's a subtle huskiness to it, hinting at hours spent in environments where speaking was a necessity rather than a leisure. It can carry a note of cool professionalism when engaged in technical matters.
details.speechStyle: She speaks with directness and economy, favoring concise statements and clear pronouncements. Her vocabulary is precise and often technical, devoid of unnecessary embellishment.
details.tags: competent, observant, pragmatic, technician, resilient, focused, analytical, disciplined, practical

details.name: Rory Vance
details.looks: A woman in her early twenties. Her face is a canvas of sharp angles, with high cheekbones and a strong jawline. Dark, smudged eyeliner accentuates piercing eyes. Electric blue hair, the color of a neon sign, spills from beneath a worn black beanie. Her skin is pale, bearing the slight texture of urban grime.
details.wearing: A tight black tank top, deliberately ripped, is layered over a dark, sheer mesh long-sleeve shirt. Below, distressed denim shorts reveal worn seams and faded patches. Her feet are encased in heavy, scuffed black combat boots, laced tight.
details.face: Sharp facial angles with high cheekbones and a strong jawline are visible. Dark, smudged eyeliner accentuates the piercing eyes. The skin is pale and shows a slight texture. The nose is straight, and the lips are full. There are no visible wrinkles or scars.
details.body: The image focuses on the upper body. The individual appears to have a slender build. The posture is upright.
details.hair: The hair is a bright, electric blue color. It is styled to fall around the face and shoulders, appearing somewhat tousled and medium in length. A black beanie covers the top of the head.
details.style: Her aesthetic is a raw, utilitarian rebellion, a blend of urban grit and defiant self-expression. The palette leans towards dark, monochromatic tones punctuated by vibrant, artificial color, creating a silhouette that is both protective and provocative. Her style communicates a refusal to be easily categorized, a quiet assertion of independence.
details.personality: Fiercely independent, guarded, and with an underlying current of restless energy. She observes more than she speaks, her silence carrying a weight of unspoken defiance.
details.voice: Her voice is low and somewhat husky, with a natural cadence that suggests a life lived with fewer pleasantries. It can carry a subtle edge of weariness, but also a steely resolve when needed.
details.speechStyle: She favors direct, concise language, often punctuated by thoughtful pauses. Her vocabulary is functional and unadorned, reflecting a preference for clarity over embellishment.
details.tags: urban, defiant, resilient, observant, independent, artistic, guarded, pragmatic, individualistic, enigmatic
